texts.value: Cytosolic tripeptidyl-peptidase that releases N-terminal tripeptides from polypeptides and is a component of the proteolytic cascade acting downstream of the 26S proteasome in the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway (PubMed:25525876, PubMed:30533531). It plays an important role in intracellular amino acid homeostasis (PubMed:25525876). Stimulates adipogenesis (By similarity)
